dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cardinal was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. The person who found Cardinal reported that he was gentle, easygoing, and calm for the day that they had him; however, he has not acclimated well to the care center environment, and has allowed only minimal handling since intake. He has shown fearful behavior on being removed from his kennel, escalating to hard barking, growling, and baring teeth. While on walks, he has remained tense and tail tucked. Due to his level of fear, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Cardinal
